design_system.title: Design system
design_system.description: Reusable Liquid components styled by the shared design tokens and this theme's merchant settings.
design_system.buttons_description: All six variant and size combinations use the shared button snippet. Enabled previews perform no action. Tab to explore keyboard focus, hover to preview feedback, and compare native disabled controls. Motion follows your device's reduced-motion preference.
design_system.foundations_description: Colors, body typography, borders, and control corners use semantic utilities rather than component-specific values. Update the theme settings to see them change together.
design_system.surface_description: The background token for content and secondary buttons.
design_system.ink_description: The foreground token for text and primary buttons.
design_system.typography_sample: One type family, a clear reading hierarchy
design_system.typography_description: The body font token follows the theme's primary font setting. Size and weight establish hierarchy without changing the family.
design_system.shape_description: This panel uses the line border and control-radius tokens. Control corners follow the theme's input corner setting.
design_system.image_description: A real Shopify image is rendered through the shared image snippet, using Shopify's image URL and image tag filters.
design_system.image_empty: Choose an example image in this section's theme-editor settings to preview the shared image component. No placeholder or external image is requested.
